evidence.en:
I, IS Q RT COM LAERTE BASTOS MATHIAS, was serving on 19/19
GTT, at approximately 5:35 PM on the day August 26, 1980, while returning from Santa Maria in the C-115 2350 air, with passengers Cel Mafra (2P), Capt J. Lopes (IP), IS Mathias (IRD, 3S Claudio (1MC), in the Galeão/Afonsos aircraft, we received a distress call from an aircraft flying directly ahead, commanded by IP, at an altitude of roughly 1,000 feet.
